<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm) are at 139.25, 134.60, 129.00 (two signals), and 128.30 (two signals), totaling six distinct aromatic carbon signals. This corresponds to six aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
